### accelerometer: gforce(2000, 1000) = 2 — ACCELEROMETER — A MOTION SENSOR, AS ARITHMETIC (chosen by the sensor registry, not by hand). ### actuation: force(50, 20) = 1000 — ACTUATION — MOVING THE WORLD, AS ARITHMETIC (chosen by the public-API registry, not by hand). ### alerting: threshold(80, 70) = 1 — ALERTING — THE ALARM LAYER, AS ARITHMETIC (what wakes an on-call engineer, in numbers).
